claims.assertion: Athena and Swaruu (9) describe physical laws as perception agreements that vary by density; in a more expansive view, no universal cosmic laws apply.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena); Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Athena says the Federation’s First Directive has imprecise, inconsistent application; her group views it as selectively used to control other groups.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says life plans are flexible ranges of potential paths, formed before incarnation and changing with a person’s interests; their broader aim is soul development.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
